Fixed in release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad): the support login locks a client out for 5 minutes after 5 wrong answers within a minute (login-throttle.ts, with a unit test). The counter is in memory, so each server instance counts for itself.

Fixed in release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad): the 13 inventory-settings writes check their own permission (typed PERMISSION_DENIED) and failed reads throw a stable code, not the request text. Reads are deliberately not permission-checked because other modules use them as lookups. getSalesChannels still returns an empty list on failure.

Fixed in release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad): the org-structure add/update/delete/assign primitives are no longer public actions, and the four action wrappers check the sales.geography create/edit/delete permission. The customer-lookup error with retry was already in place.
Fixed in release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad): the sidebar flask link to the component gallery is shown only outside production. The /examples route already answered 404 in a production build.
Closed after checking release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad): only one getInitials helper is left in the settings code, the duplicates are gone.
Fixed in release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad): the unused duplicate ROLE_LABEL in features/settings/field-force/constants.ts was removed; one definition remains in the facade.

Fixed in release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad, MR fix/warehouse-label-descendants): the subtree of a location is collected in one pass with a parent-to-children map instead of scanning the whole list per node. Unit test descendants.test.ts (5,050 nodes). Not timed on a real 5,000-bin warehouse.
Fixed in release_beta_1.0.0 (047aedad): eslint now fails an import of '@/erp-api/api-client' inside src/features. The one existing violation (an unused vendor-return bin action) was removed.
